failure.cause: The new initial require_gpu_task call accessed self.lake on the established legacy early-refusal test object, whose sealed drift must be rejected without a Lake. This AttributeError preempted that existing refusal path.

fix.rationale: require_gpu_task already supports no-Lake callers and consults the declared/current catalog in that branch. Supplying None does not grant native CPU dispatch. Keeping this optional parameter preserves existing controller/sealed ordering and the new CPU kind exclusion before slots/claim.
